ablations.configuration_chain: run DirectedCutOnly on the fixed 45-query panel; reuse matching production Base/Enhanced records
ablations.endpoint_floor: build in an isolated git archive with exactly one registered expression changed from max(farthest, endpoint-floor) to farthest, pass all CTest, then run Base and Enhanced on the fixed 45-query panel
ablations.stop_on: any completed objective/feasibility mismatch or any build diff outside the registered expression

current_formal_policy.supersedes: the historical likely_timeout_stop, ordering, and phase_order fields retained below
current_formal_policy.rule: every independent P1/P2/S2 task key has a real ok or real 3600-second timeout outcome; no sibling-query or cross-g prediction is executable
current_formal_policy.diagnostic_policy: RSS and native-state candidates remain shadow-only and never alter the formal ledger

diagnostic_evidence.decision: not activated: zero observed false stops is insufficient to establish an extreme future probability, and graph/cell dependence makes the descriptive binomial bounds optimistic

enhanced_timeout_policy.historical_reuse: raw same-binary exact outcomes are retained; a reporting-only copy uses timeout_seconds=3600 and censors every raw solver_seconds>3600 completion to timeout without modifying the source record
enhanced_timeout_policy.rule: run every not-yet-performed Enhanced task with the common 3600-second per-query limit and continue after timeout; no result-dependent query replacement or campaign-wide hard stop

P1.formal_reporting: materialize all 24954 records at TL=3600; two PrunedDP++ DBpedia completions above 3600 become formal timeout, while all Base/Enhanced P1 records remain completed
requirements: current task-key set exactly equals the archived 8318 queries times three methods

P2_Enhanced.formal_reporting: three Orkut completions above 3600 become formal timeout; all raw exact objectives remain read-only correctness references
requirements: the current 660 task keys, graph/query paths and g values match exactly
all 660 records contain exact completed outcomes

S2_g15_Enhanced.action: retain and reuse all 100 byte-identical g=15 query outcomes; do not rerun or overwrite them
S2_g15_Enhanced.design_chronology: g=15 was generated and measured first; g={3,6,9,12} was added on 2026-08-28 and must not be described as preregistered before the g=15 run
S2_g15_Enhanced.formal_reporting: retain exact objectives, but count every solver_seconds>3600 record as timeout under the common formal TL; report every g separately as well as graph totals

superseded_likely_timeout_stop.status: historical-only; disproved as an extreme-probability rule by real backfill successes and never executable in the current policy

P2_cross_g.action: do not start q6--q10 at that g or any query at larger g for that graph/method
P2_cross_g.evidence: for one fixed graph, g and method, all preregistered tranche-1 q1--q5 (one per input-size stratum) reach the real 3600-second limit and Enhanced completes those five within 3600 seconds
P2_cross_g.scope: same graph and method; larger g only

S2_controlled_gf.action: do not start the same f at larger g for that graph/method
S2_controlled_gf.evidence: for one fixed graph, f, g and method, all ten queries reach the real 3600-second limit and Enhanced completes those same ten within 3600 seconds
S2_controlled_gf.scope: same graph, method and f; larger g only; never extrapolate across f

shared.no_solver_progress_threshold: do not infer from method-specific queue/state rates or kill a currently running query early; only completed real-timeout records trigger a lane decision
shared.reporting: never count a predicted-stop task as formal timeout, solved, elapsed time, PAR-2 input, or a completed matrix cell; retain every skipped task key, scope and real timeout evidence key for optional later rerun

historical_ordering.P2_Enhanced_estimate: not used: all 660 current-binary P2 Enhanced tasks are already complete and identity-audited
historical_ordering.S2_Enhanced_estimate: schedule g={3,6,9,12} in ascending g; within one g use a same-graph/g/f historical probe when available, otherwise deterministic graph-size times subset-count work; retained g=15 is not rescheduled
historical_ordering.S2_competitors: ascending g frontier; deterministic estimated fast-to-slow order within each g so the same-f 10/10 timeout rule can be updated online
historical_ordering.fallback: deterministic graph-size times subset-count score, used only if a historical estimate is absent
historical_ordering.scientific_effect: none; ordering changes neither solver, timeout nor reporting

paper_scope: P1/P2/S2 main matrix plus the separately preregistered minimal ablations
historical_phase_order: validate binary/matrix/input identities; materialize non-destructive 3600-second views of historical P1/P2/S2-g15 records
run the 40 new S2 g={3,6,9,12} cells (400 queries) for Enhanced from estimated fast to slow and continue after timeout
run P2 Base and PrunedDP++ in ascending g frontiers, applying the symmetric five-timeout likely-stop rule online
run S2 Base and PrunedDP++ in ascending g frontiers, applying the symmetric same-f ten-timeout likely-stop rule online
run the two preregistered minimal ablation panels at the same 3600-second limit
